subject: prd/installer
statement: When Pyxis is installed, repaired, diagnosed, or released, the system shall perform those operations without Node.js, npm, package installation, or a JavaScript dependency archive, and the shipped payload shall contain only declared runtime assets.
rationale: one self-contained payload reduces the installation and supply-chain surface
fit_criterion: with Node.js and npm absent, init and doctor complete, repair restores the expected owned files, release packaging produces verified binaries, payload, manifest, and checksums, and the clean-room entrypoint passes preflight; new manifests omit a dependency archive; standalone feedback capture writes its expected record and Go plan rendering emits its expected HTML
